## Run it without the OS

`graph.mjs` is the team as plain LangGraph JS (`@langchain/langgraph` + `langchain`), the same file the
OS loads. It exports `buildGraph({ model, tools, middleware, checkpointer })`. Prompts are in `prompts/`.

```sh
npm install
OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... OPENAI_MODEL=<model> \
  node run.mjs --input "$(jq -r .cases[0].input evals/cases.json)" --stub-tools
node -e "import('./graph.mjs').then(m => console.log(JSON.stringify(m.TEAM, null, 2)))"
```

Tool interface (implement these, or pass '--stub-tools'): 'get_dataset', 'list_datasets', 'profile_dataset', 'query_data'.
Entry agent: 'triage'. Upstream docs: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/graph-api,
https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langchain/agents.
